name: Hornero Date Calculator
description: Utility Tools 2.0 date calculator: bar quick action and compact dashboard detail for days-between and add-days on validated YYYY-MM-DD dates, using UTC math to avoid DST drift.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Second action button uses the same secondary style as the first.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: tokens ported.

Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard date calculator: days-between and add-days with UTC math.

deprecation.message: Retired: Toolbox covers this tool (and six siblings) in one Signal card with typed settings and live results; this extension keeps working where installed.

showUtcNote.description: Show the UTC-math note in the dashboard panel (the 1.x behaviour).
